CIVIL AVIATION ACT 1969

CIVIL AVIATION (EXEMPTION) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 3(2) (p) of the
Civil Aviation Act 1969 [Act 3], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Civil Aviation (Exemption)
Regulations 2018.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 15 April 2018.

Exemption
2. The Fire and Rescue Department of Malaysia is exempted from the payment of
fees and charges  specified in  paragraph 21 of the Schedule to the Civil Aviation
(Fees and Charges) Regulations 2016 [P.U. (A) 99/2016] in relation to the application for
renewal of certificate of airworthiness for aircrafts with the registration numbers
specified in the Schedule.
